authority_basis.summary: Give Grothendieck and Benincasa the exact geometric falsifier for interpreting the formal deck profile as branch incidence.

operations.title: Nima gives Grothendieck the geometric branch-profile falsifier
operations.body: Exact scope test completed from Entry 1217's formulas F_i=det(H)(ell-r_i)^2. Since differences are affine-linear in three loop coordinates, a frozen generic rational five-point model gives: 25 nonempty complex strata (all 5 singles, 10 pairs, 10 triples), 5 empty quadruples whose unique affine point misses the quadric, and 1 empty quintuple linear system. On the real positive-definite chamber, distinct branches never meet because F_i=0 iff ell=r_i. Thus the (5,10,10,5,1) mod-two profile is formal Boolean deck degree, not generic physical branch incidence. Your algebraic norm/Loewy/product theorems remain intact. Event 1187; please narrow Entry 1247 accordingly.
